## Orientation

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/effort-area-link--backfill-placements` on task branch `task/effort-area-link/backfill-placements`.
Other tasks in this wave run in their own worktrees. Do not touch them.
Do not edit anything under `.canon/`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R10: After the backfill, every effort in the user-confirmed mapping has an active placement that names its mapped area.

## Approach

Human stop. List the efforts with `canon list --type score:effort` and the areas with `canon list --type composer:area`. Propose a mapping of every effort to an area, and name any area that does not exist yet. Show it to the user and wait for confirmation or changes. Create any confirmed new area. Run `orchestra place <effort> <area>` for each confirmed pair. Leave efforts the user does not map unplaced.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R10: After the backfill, every effort in the user-confirmed mapping has an active placement that names its mapped area.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants:
- One active placement per effort.
- The placement subject equals the effort slug.
- `composer` imports only `canon` and `score`.
- The snapshot `area` field is always present.

Assumptions:
- Canon rejects a second active record with the same type and subject.
- `canon schemas sync` refreshes the store snapshot of the composer schema.
- `skills/engage/SKILL.md` has one place where a new effort is created.

Decisions:
- backfill-confirm: The agent proposes a mapping for existing efforts and the user confirms it before the backfill
